description: openMSN provides an open proxy connecting geographically distributed maritime simulators through UDP multicast and Zenoh. The provider is RISE Maritime. Geographical and temporal coverage: The software extends local simulator communication across sites; it does not supply a geographic navigation scenario. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is Apache-2.0. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
